meta.name: English
update.badge.label: Update available: Papyra {version}. Show details.
update.dialog.title: New version available
update.dialog.lede: A new version of Papyra is available. Please take a moment to read the <link>release notes</link> before you update, especially if something updates your container for you.
update.dialog.fine: Papyra looks at GitHub once a day. Nothing about your server is sent.
settings.title: Settings
settings.area.label: Settings area
settings.serverNote: Changes here apply to everyone on this server.
settings.git.title: Git backup
settings.git.hint: A copy of your notes on GitHub or another Git host. Every change is kept.
settings.mail.title: Mail server
settings.backupFile.title: Backup file
settings.serverBackup.title: Server backup
settings.serverBackup.loadError: Couldn’t load the server backup settings.
settings.channels.loadError: Couldn’t load the chat service settings.
settings.users.roleAdmin: Admin — can also manage accounts and server settings
settings.sso.existingOnly: Existing accounts only — SSO never creates one. Add people under Server settings → Users first.
notifications.where.title: Where to send
notifications.email.ok: Email goes to your account address.
notifications.email.noAddress: Your account has no email address yet. Add one under Profile.
notifications.email.off: The administrator hasn’t set up email.
notifications.ntfy.intro: Get notifications on your phone or desktop with the ntfy app. No account needed.
notifications.discord.intro: Get notifications as a Discord message.
notifications.telegram.intro: Get notifications from a Telegram bot.
notifications.service.offByAdmin: An administrator turned this off for the whole server.
notifications.service.unconfirmed: Not confirmed yet. Send a test, then say it arrived.
settings.channels.networkHint: Papyra connects only to public internet addresses unless you list a server here.
settings.git.plain.title: Anyone who can read the repository can read your notes.
settings.git.plain.body: They are saved as plain Markdown files. Locked notes stay locked. Keep the repository private, or switch on encryption above.
git.guide.filesPlain: Plain files — notes, to-dos, locked notes, media and settings
git.guide.plainNote: Backups become plain Markdown files. Locked notes stay locked.
journal.locking.footer: Locked days can’t be read outside Papyra — not in your folder, your backups or a Git copy. You open them with your Vault PIN.
journal.use.footer: Turning it off hides the Journal. Your days stay exactly as they are.
journal.reminder.hint: One email a day, only if you haven’t written yet. It never says what you wrote.
settings.git.hostHint: Any Git host that accepts an access token.
vault.pin.label: Vault PIN
vault.pin.hint: Opens your locked notes. It isn’t your password.
vault.pin.disabled: Turned off after too many wrong tries
vault.openHere: The vault is open on this device
vault.removePasskeyTip: Open the vault to remove a passkey
vault.pill.tip: The vault is open on this device, so locked notes can be read. It closes itself after 5 idle minutes.
vault.copyTip: Open the vault to copy this note
vault.downloadTip: Open the vault to download this note
common.serverUnreachable: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
backupFile.download.value: A password-protected copy of every note and file
backupFile.forgot: If you forget the password, the file can’t be opened.
settings.sso.matched: Matched by email the first time, then by the provider’s account ID
notifications.discord.notReady: Discord isn’t ready to connect yet. Ask an administrator.
notifications.discord.kindDm: A direct message. Only you see it.
notifications.discord.kindWebhook: A message in a channel. Everyone in the channel sees it.
notifications.ntfy.topicHint: Anyone who knows the topic can read your notifications, so use a long one.
notifications.discord.dmNeeds: You and the bot need a Discord server in common, and your Discord privacy settings must allow direct messages from server members.
notifications.email.notSetUp: Email isn’t set up on this server yet.
settings.channels.discord.hint: Direct messages from a bot, or messages in a channel.
settings.channels.discord.allowHint: Everyone in the channel can read them.
settings.serverBackup.passphraseHint: Choose one before the first backup. It opens every server backup and can’t be recovered, so keep it somewhere other than this server.
settings.serverBackup.localHint: One encrypted file a day, kept on this server. It protects against a damaged database, not a lost disk.
settings.serverBackup.gitHint: Sends the same encrypted file to a Git repository once a day. Use a private repository of its own, not one that holds notes.
settings.serverBackup.restoreHint: For a new or damaged server. Notes come back from their folders or from each person’s Git backup.
setup.username.hint: How you sign in and how people @mention you. It’s unique on this server.
setup.password.hint: At least 8 characters. It also opens your encrypted backups.
shared.empty.body: When someone on this server shares a note with you, it shows up here — and on your Notes page too — with who shared it, when, and whether you can edit it.
error.panel.hint: If this keeps happening, send the copied details to whoever runs this server.
